so.text: Both put $335,437 into the retiree health trust; the draft adds stabilization, capital and a reserve for next year.

today.quote: The highest priority use of Free Cash should be to increase the balance of the Stabilization Account if necessary to a level of at least five percent of the current fiscal year omnibus budget

draft.quote: Appropriate at least 10 percent to the Town’s other postemployment benefits (OPEB) trust fund

today.quote: The next highest priority use of Free Cash should be to fund an amount equivalent to at last 10% of the previous fiscal year’s certified General Fund Free Cash for deposit into the OPEB Trust Fund
The amount is to be calculated each fiscal year during the capital planning process

moves.text: Decides where this year's free cash goes, so it changes what is left for Town Meeting.

target.label: Planning target
target.text: A range a balance is measured against. It moves no money by itself; the dials reach it or do not.

text.annual_note: The draft also sets a yearly stabilization deposit from the operating budget, not from free cash: 0.25% in its summary table, 0.3% in its text.
text.audit_note: The FY2025 audit prints the general stabilization balance as $3,237,894, not $3,147,179; the calculator starts from the figure the state's databank also prints.
text.budget_note: One budget figure is used wherever a rule names the current or the prior year's budget; edit it to test another year.
text.cap_reading: Our reading: today's "total of all funds" is taken as every stabilization fund, general and special purpose together.
text.floors_note: The draft's shares are floors ("at least"); its setting puts each dial at its floor.
text.kinds_note: Which kind each rule is, is our reading of the two documents.
text.order_note: The dials are applied in the order shown, each from what is left: today's policy is written as a priority list.

uses.label: Left for Town Meeting to decide

so.text: Under today's rules most of the free cash is left for Town Meeting to decide; under the draft most of it is assigned before Town Meeting sees it.

blocks.title: Free cash, rule by rule

paragraphs.text: This project recommends neither rule set. The calculator applies each as printed to figures the town has published, and to any figures you type. The boards decide.

blocks.title: What this page does not say

paragraphs.text: What each rule says, how the reserves have moved against them, the retiree health liability, and the public argument.

finding.text: Today’s rules leave $3,018,933 of $3,354,370 in free cash to Town Meeting; the draft leaves $924,030.
